title: Vanish-Slot
description: Small Fabric mod that adds a toggleable trash slot to the player inventory.
body: Small Fabric mod that adds a toggleable trash slot to the player's inventory. You can use a keybind to toggle it on and off and use a keybind to delete items. This is my first mod so feel free to create issues or suggestions on the [Github](https://github.com/TM1988/Vanish-MC/issues)!
